agent.finish_summary: Fixed reindent formatting across statement boundaries. ReindentFilter now removes all leading whitespace tokens from a newly split statement before determining whether its leading DML/DDL token needs an internal line break. This prevents an extra newline when source statements are already separated by newlines or blank lines, while retaining the standard two-newline formatted statement separator. Verified space, LF, CRLF, multiple blank-line, and indented-boundary inputs all consistently produce `select foo;\n\nselect bar`; compilation succeeds. The checkout contains no test suite, so `pytest` reported no tests collected.
